```{r}
#| label: setup
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)

# CBB_DASH_DATA (an .rds of build_dashboard_data() output) renders without the pipeline
f <- Sys.getenv("CBB_DASH_DATA")
d <- if (nzchar(f)) readRDS(f) else tar_read(dashboard_data)
# The latest snapshot with a resume (in the preseason, last season's final)
has_resume <- d$ranks |> filter(!is.na(wab)) |> distinct(s, w)
pick <- has_resume |> arrange(s, w) |> slice_tail(n = 1)
season <- pick$s
snap <- d$snaps |> filter(s == season, w == pick$w)
d1 <- d$ranks |> filter(s == season, w == pick$w)
bench <- round(snap$bench_rank)
label <- function(s) sprintf("%d-%02d", s - 1, s %% 100)

c_resume <- "#3a6ea5"; c_power <- "#d1622a"; c_ink <- "#222222"; c_muted <- "#77756f"
theme_report <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.title.position = "plot",
        axis.title = element_text(color = c_muted))
rec <- function(w, l) paste0(w, "–", l)
```

Season **`r label(season)`**, through **`r snap$label`** (`r snap$n_games` games, field of
`r snap$field`). Estimated home-court edge: **`r sprintf("%.1f", snap$hca)` points** at an
average tempo (`r sprintf("%.1f", snap$hca100)` per 100 possessions).

## Resume: what teams have earned

A team's resume is its **wins above bubble (WAB)**. Each D1 game scores 1 − P(the bubble team
would have won it) for a win and −P(…) for a loss, with opponent strength and venue from the
Power model. The bubble team is the last at-large team in: about #`r bench` in the power
ranking once the automatic bids and ineligible teams are set aside. Zero means a team has done
exactly what a bubble team would have.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-resume
#| tbl-cap: "Top 25 by resume"
d1 |>
  arrange(rrk) |>
  slice_head(n = 25) |>
  transmute(Rank = rrk, Team = team, Conf = conf, Record = rec(wins, losses),
            WAB = wab, `80% interval` = sprintf("%+.2f to %+.2f", wab_lo, wab_hi),
            `Rank range` = sprintf("%d–%d", rrk_lo, rrk_hi), Q1 = rec(q1w, q1l),
            `SOS rank` = sos_rk, Power = prk, AP = ap, Seed = seed) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(WAB, decimals = 2, force_sign = TRUE) |>
  sub_missing(missing_text = "–") |>
  data_color(WAB, palette = c("#eef1f4", c_resume)) |>
  tab_style(cell_text(weight = "bold"), cells_body(columns = c(Rank, Team)))
```

## Power: how good teams are

Power ratings are points per 100 possessions better than an average D1 team on a neutral floor;
offence and defence split the rating using the tempo-free scoring model (defence: points
allowed, lower is better).

```{r}
#| label: tbl-power
#| tbl-cap: "Top 25 by power"
d1 |>
  arrange(prk) |>
  slice_head(n = 25) |>
  transmute(Rank = prk, Team = team, Conf = conf, Record = rec(wins, losses),
            Rating = pw, `80% interval` = sprintf("%+.1f to %+.1f", pw_lo, pw_hi),
            `Rank range` = sprintf("%d–%d", prk_lo, prk_hi),
            Off = off, `Off rank` = off_rk, Def = def, `Def rank` = def_rk, Tempo = tempo, Resume = rrk) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(c(Rating, Off, Def), decimals = 1) |>
  fmt_number(Tempo, decimals = 1) |>
  data_color(Rating, palette = c("#fbeee6", c_power)) |>
  tab_style(cell_text(weight = "bold"), cells_body(columns = c(Rank, Team)))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-scatter
#| fig-cap: "Resume (WAB) against Power rating. Labelled: top 16 by either measure."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6
lab <- d1 |> filter(rrk <= 16 | prk <= 16)
ggplot(d1, aes(pw, wab)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = c_resume) +
  geom_point(aes(color = !is.na(seed)), size = 2, alpha = 0.75, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = lab, aes(label = team), vjust = -0.9, size = 3, color = c_ink, check_overlap = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = c_resume, `FALSE` = "#a9b5c3")) +
  labs(x = "Power rating (points per 100 vs. average D1 team)", y = "Wins above bubble",
       caption = if (any(!is.na(d1$seed))) "Blue: in the NCAA tournament field" else NULL) +
  theme_report
```

## The field

From the season simulation: the rest of the regular season and every conference tournament
played out in each posterior draw, the champions taking the automatic bids and projected WAB
picking the at-large teams. Once the season is over these are 0 or 1.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-bubble
#| tbl-cap: "Bubble: at-large chances between 10% and 90%"
bub <- d1 |> filter(elig, p_al >= 0.1, p_al <= 0.9) |> arrange(desc(p_field))
if (!nrow(bub) || all(is.na(d1$p_field))) {
  cat("No bubble at this snapshot.")
} else {
  bub |>
    transmute(Team = team, Conf = conf, Record = rec(wins, losses), WAB = wab, `Projected WAB` = proj_wab,
              `P(auto)` = p_auto, `P(at-large)` = p_al, `P(field)` = p_field, Q1 = rec(q1w, q1l), Power = prk) |>
    gt() |>
    fmt_number(c(WAB, `Projected WAB`), decimals = 2, force_sign = TRUE) |>
    fmt_percent(starts_with("P("), decimals = 0)
}
```

## Schedule strength and luck

**SOS** is the bubble team's expected loss rate against the schedule (higher = harder).
**Luck** is wins minus expected wins, where expected wins use the team's own rating.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-luck
#| tbl-cap: "Luckiest and unluckiest D1 teams"
bind_rows(
  d1 |> arrange(desc(luck)) |> slice_head(n = 8),
  d1 |> arrange(luck) |> slice_head(n = 8)
) |>
  transmute(Team = team, Record = rec(wins, losses), Luck = luck, Resume = rrk, Power = prk) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(Luck, decimals = 1, force_sign = TRUE) |>
  tab_row_group("Least lucky", rows = 9:16) |>
  tab_row_group("Most lucky", rows = 1:8)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sos
#| tbl-cap: "Hardest schedules"
d1 |>
  arrange(sos_rk) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  transmute(`SOS rank` = sos_rk, Team = team, Record = rec(wins, losses),
            `Bubble loss rate` = sos, Resume = rrk, Power = prk) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_percent(`Bubble loss rate`, decimals = 0)
```

## Polls

```{r}
#| label: tbl-polls
#| tbl-cap: "Model vs. AP poll (the latest release on or before the snapshot). Gap = AP − Resume; unranked = 30."
if (all(is.na(d1$ap))) {
  cat("No AP poll matches this snapshot.")
} else {
  d1 |>
    filter(!is.na(ap) | rrk <= 25) |>
    mutate(gap = coalesce(ap, 30L) - rrk) |>
    arrange(desc(abs(gap))) |>
    transmute(Team = team, Record = rec(wins, losses), Resume = rrk, Power = prk,
              AP = ap, Coaches = coaches, Colley = colley_rk, Gap = gap) |>
    gt() |>
    sub_missing(missing_text = "–")
}
```
